name: The Living Record
purpose: Keep a person's account, witness material, work context, decisions and continuity through eight independent Places.
access_boundaries: Private by default; no requirement to visit all Places, disclose underlying work or grant others access.

name: Room to Pause
purpose: Permit pause, departure and return without making availability a condition of standing.
access_boundaries: No passive recording, compulsory explanation, check-in, loss of standing or inferred consent; actual duties keep their lawful route.

name: Private Records Office
purpose: Keep originals and appropriately authorized private evidence and correction history.
access_boundaries: No public enumeration, cross-person access, unrestricted administrator inference or disclosure from a public receipt.

name: Public Records Office
purpose: Offer authorized public research, cited records, corrections and contrary material.
access_boundaries: Public edition allowlist only; private Nurture originals and reports are never made public by indexing.

name: New Work Security
purpose: Protect attributable emerging work and continuity without converting support into privilege.
access_boundaries: Money, title, family, support or contribution alone creates no access or design authority; valid grants remain operative.

name: Dependents' Rights
purpose: Make standing, evidence, process and the full recovered protection collections usable without prejudging people.
access_boundaries: No diagnosis, capacity ruling, universal veto, forced monitoring, automatic law claim or adverse score about a person.

name: Informal Pressure
purpose: Preserve exact reports, boundaries, context and impacts without constructing a dossier or verdict.
access_boundaries: No inferred coercion, motive or misconduct from role, money, number of people, silence or disagreement.

name: Misplaced Suspicion
purpose: Help document suspicion, allegations and mischaracterized professional work without promoting them to findings.
access_boundaries: Private intake is distinct from public guide; attachment and receipt capability cannot be assumed.

name: Design Against Crime
purpose: Provide a separately governed independent reporting/research contract within its actual service remit.
access_boundaries: Service receipt is not police incident number; no government submission, referral, endorsement or finding by default.

name: Responsible Charge
purpose: Preserve independent professional judgment, actual responsibility and the scope of technical authority.
access_boundaries: No license or authority inferred from self-label, property, payer, relationship or organizational title; preserve valid contracts and legal roles.

name: Receipt Logic
purpose: Provide bounded evidence/receipt semantics across work, payment, boundaries and community.
access_boundaries: Missing receipt is not breach; delivery, acknowledgment, acceptance, finding and payment are separate events.

name: Boundary Receipt Printer
purpose: Render a bounded acknowledgment linked to a private boundary record, physically or digitally.
access_boundaries: Issuance is not delivery, assent, service, truth or fault. Public QR/URL must not reveal private supporting material.

name: Nurture and its libraries
purpose: Expose reusable library concepts and scoped owner adapters while preserving private early work.
access_boundaries: Dream, Venture, Pattern, Patent, Instrument and Step remain distinct; private shelves are never public catalog entries.

name: Heard and its Experience Adapter
purpose: Carry one listening/stewardship system through experience-appropriate interactions.
access_boundaries: No passive listening; no product-specific authority forks; adapter cannot create or publish on a person's behalf.

name: Center for the Dream
purpose: Offer practical resources for independent work and other needs without compelled disclosure.
access_boundaries: No eligibility, placement or availability guarantee; no personal hardship used as incapacity or forced intake.

name: Practical Possibilities
purpose: Help developers make practical next steps available while preserving independent work.
access_boundaries: Suggestions do not accept terms, incur cost, claim eligibility or create a relationship; no forced personal disclosure.

name: Independent Work Protection
purpose: Enforce bounded authority at effects affecting authorship, work and professional judgment.
access_boundaries: Client-side allow is advisory; server effects require owner-side checks. Support/payment never implies design authority.

name: Promise-to-Step
purpose: Bind authored promises to properly established instruments without treating action completion as promise fulfillment.
access_boundaries: KEPT-BY distinct from BEARS-ON; candidate is not established; task action-step distinct from capital-S Step.

name: Journey Verification
purpose: Determine scoped fulfillment from actual experience, governing standards and outcomes.
access_boundaries: No self-reported completed flag, map completeness, passing schema or majority score becomes fulfilled experience.

name: Experience Stewardship
purpose: Turn observed experience gaps into accountable correction and learning.
access_boundaries: Reports, interpretations and findings distinct; no forced participant disclosure or automated human consensus.

name: Experience Maps
purpose: Make actual functional paths, distinct reported experience and provenance inspectable.
access_boundaries: One selected journey does not discard other projects/journeys; emotional path never inferred from functional telemetry.

name: Journey Registry
purpose: Expose canonical journey identities, relationships, mental models and evidence through bounded projections.
access_boundaries: No second registry; access-filter private journeys before search, counts or metadata.

name: Activity Centers
purpose: Make each journey, correction and learning item accountable to its actual practice.
access_boundaries: References journey IDs owned elsewhere; cannot rename, merge or create journeys or appoint authority by label.

name: Center of Excellence
purpose: Assess quality and convert reviewed learning into reusable institutional knowledge.
access_boundaries: No review board replacement or human-worth score; don't convert engagement into value.

name: Human Stewardship Guidelines
purpose: Make exact governing sources, version applicability and conformance obligations executable without automating human judgment.
access_boundaries: Guideline availability never grants access; permission decisions separate from human review outcomes.

name: Public Research
purpose: Serve inspectable public research with primary sources, dates, methods and limits.
access_boundaries: No private-case leakage, fabricated authority, universal coverage claim or repeated-source event inflation.

name: Pattern Development
purpose: Develop patterns from evidence while distinguishing proposal, adoption and actual effect.
access_boundaries: No automated misconduct label, diagnosis or institutional finding; deduplicate underlying events.

name: Community Support
purpose: Enable practical support without giving participants control over one another's work.
access_boundaries: No compulsory hardship story, public identity, diagnosis, gratitude, check-in or transfer of authorship; valid community rules still apply.

name: Research and Educational Resources
purpose: Provide practical learning and licensed research in developers' existing environments.
access_boundaries: No fake enrollment, credential, license access or completion; no forced internal application adoption.

name: Center for the Song
purpose: Offer the wider audio instrumentation ecosystem as modular public contracts.
access_boundaries: Independent applications may use relevant modules without adopting SongSketch, a label, publisher or distributor.

name: SongSketch integration adapter
purpose: Connect SongSketch records while keeping reusable protections application-independent.
access_boundaries: No SongSketch account required for local schemas; owner-service access must be explicit.

name: SongGraph
purpose: Document a song's relationships and bounded evidence of its continuing online presence.
access_boundaries: Public URL is not permission to copy protected media; no universal coverage or continuous-monitoring claim.

name: Song Invite
purpose: Invite someone into a specified part of a song's life with bounded participation.
access_boundaries: Invitation/access/acceptance/contribution/authorship/ownership/decision authority separate; no automatic forwarding or unrestricted access.

name: SongDev
purpose: Provide development standards/specifications for building around songs while preserving identity.
access_boundaries: No claim of deployment from tutorial/example; no need to rebuild a developer's product.

name: SongGit
purpose: Preserve source material, versions and creative lineage.
access_boundaries: Canonical spelling recovered as SongGit. SongGet remains an unconfirmed alias; no automatic rename.

name: Creative attribution and song provenance
purpose: Keep authorship, performance, arrangement, production and source contribution legible.
access_boundaries: Authorship is not automatically ownership; payment, generation, invitation or hosting confers neither.

name: Arrangement Credits
purpose: Represent prepaid preparation entitlements without confusing them with artistic credit.
access_boundaries: No charge, consumption, refund, transfer, expiry or changed policy from SDK inspection; no invented financial terms.

name: Song preservation
purpose: Keep musical source and context independently recoverable.
access_boundaries: No global permanence, bit-perfect playback or copyright transfer from storing a file.

name: Song research
purpose: Research songs, versions, references and development context with bounded coverage.
access_boundaries: No universal internet discovery, unlicensed bulk copying, auto attribution or monitoring.

name: Natural language and understanding
purpose: Turn deliberately supplied language into inspectable interpretations while preserving exact originals.
access_boundaries: No passive audio capture, inferred speaker authority, diagnosis or execution from fluent text.

name: Translation and localization editions
purpose: Create meaning-preserving derived editions with block-level provenance and review.
access_boundaries: No silent changes to promises, permissions, boundaries, legal effect, decisions or attribution; original remains canonical.

name: Terminology management
purpose: Preserve governed concepts with contextual forms and explicit rejected literals.
access_boundaries: No global blind synonym substitution or silent reintroduction of rejected terminology.

name: Accessible explanations
purpose: Provide understandable explanations without changing the underlying decision or source.
access_boundaries: No simplification that changes permission/obligation or infers comprehension, disability or capacity.

name: Internationalization and multilingual experience
purpose: Make locale, direction, formatting and interaction usable across platforms.
access_boundaries: Do not derive language from IP, country or timezone; display formatting never changes stored authority/time/money.

name: Correction and recovery
purpose: Preserve traceable corrections, uncertainty and return after failure.
access_boundaries: No silent overwrite, fabricated missing original, unconditional permanent retention or unrelated rights expansion.

name: Founding Record and venture provenance
purpose: Preserve venture origin, intent and attributable development alongside song protections.
access_boundaries: Origin/authorship distinct from assigned ownership; no duplication of Founding Ledger or Nurture owners.

name: Exact-edition publication and authorized public export
purpose: Make precise approved public editions available without leaking private source.
access_boundaries: Read-only v1 never publishes; preparation, approval, publish, delivery and readback remain separate.

name: Quality Assurance and Preventative Care instruments
purpose: Expose distinct Dark Pattern Prevention, Context Displacement Prevention and Freelancer's Protection contracts.
access_boundaries: Do not merge three protections or replace their original visual objects; avoid universal automated certification.

name: Internal concept to public meaning
purpose: Preserve meaning while explaining internal concepts appropriately to public audiences.
access_boundaries: No disclosure of private framework names simply because an internal source was supplied; no weaker substitute meaning.

name: Experience Center
purpose: Provide an appropriate inspection/learning entry point across experience contracts.
access_boundaries: Do not alias to CoE, Activity Centers, or Experience Stewardship Room without canonical source reconciliation.

name: Engineering, building-code and standards research
purpose: Help find applicable authoritative standards and educational references with licensing and jurisdiction intact.
access_boundaries: No unlicensed redistribution, code-compliance certification or engineering/legal judgment from retrieval alone.

name: Offline validation and public preservation
purpose: Keep SDK contracts, examples and local protections useful after company-domain loss.
access_boundaries: No secret or private source in public pack; no cloud availability claim from local success.

name: HeadsUp and attention protection
purpose: Give timely, bounded information about what matters while protecting attention.
access_boundaries: No passive surveillance, manufactured urgency or unrelated behavioral profile.

name: Living Laboratory and instrument evidence
purpose: Carry observations, measurements, negative results and development standing through the existing instrument registry.
access_boundaries: Private experiments and source/IP remain owner-controlled; no second registry.

name: Posterity Reader and whole-edition reading
purpose: Provide accessible whole editions with canonical original and authorized translations preserved.
access_boundaries: Only approved public/authorized text; no private manuscript or translation publication implied.

name: Governance Support
purpose: Preserve governed commitments and the authority/process/evidence of amendments and actions.
access_boundaries: No title-based blanket authority or mutation of protected original commitments.

name: NapkinSketch capture and venture founding adapter
purpose: Let developers preserve an original idea and refer to deliberate venture founding without requiring NapkinSketch adoption.
access_boundaries: Capture only offered/authorized material; private ideas stay private; founding is deliberate and scoped.

name: LOX commissioned and memorial work stewardship adapter
purpose: Preserve entrusted commissioned/memorial material, independent identity and deliberate publication choices.
access_boundaries: Private by default; no automatic public catalog, training permission or merging of independent LOX identity into another product.

name: Non-destructive song arrangement and editing
purpose: Preserve master recordings and versioned arrangement/edit decisions across applications.
access_boundaries: No write over the only original; contribution and media access separate; publishing/export need scope.

name: Dark Pattern Prevention Instrument
purpose: Make manipulative interaction patterns inspectable while preserving a person's agency.
access_boundaries: No diagnosis of designer/user intent or automatic verdict from a visual pattern name.

name: Context Displacement Prevention Instrument
purpose: Keep original context available when work is quoted, summarized or reframed.
access_boundaries: No exposure of private context beyond permissions; no summary replaces original.

name: Freelancer’s Protection Instrument
purpose: Keep independent work, context and a person's circumstances distinct while supporting continuity.
access_boundaries: No compulsory disclosure of hardship or private client material; support does not convey design authority.
